highlights_led_by_exploit_ready_vulns: CISA decides weekly vulnerability bulletin isn't necessary anymore and ConnectWise ScreenConnect bug exploited in the wild, CISA says. Treat newly published PoCs and early exploitation signals as immediate patch/mitigation triggers for internet-facing and fleet-wide infrastructure.
endpoint_posture_under_pressure: Iranian hackers use CHOSEN BRICK Windows malware to spy on targets. Tighten EDR coverage, block known IoCs where available, and validate software supply-chain integrity in build and CI/CD.
identity_and_edge_access_risks: Spain's data agency gets first report of AI-powered data breach. Prioritize MFA enforcement, phishing-resistant authentication, and reduce management-plane exposure for edge services and remote access.
